description: This file defines the SystemTargetBasedMembershipTable class implementing the IMembershipTable interface, along with related classes like MembershipTableSystemTarget, which manage membership table interactions within Orleans runtime, including initialization, CRUD operations, and internal logging.

classes.name: SystemTargetBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface to manage membership state in Orleans runtime, including initialization, reading, updating, and deletion of membership data via a system target.

classes.name: MembershipTableSystemTarget
classes.description: Represents a system target for membership table, responsible for in-memory membership data management and lifecycle participation within Silo.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, potentially trying to initialize the version.

methods.name: GetMembershipTable
methods.description: Retrieves the system target managing the membership table, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: WaitForTableGrainToInit
methods.description: Waits until the membership table grain is initialized and ready, with retries and logging.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries for a specified cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific silo's membership data.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads the entire membership table data.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry into the table.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the liveness status of a membership entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes stale or dead silo entries based on a timestamp.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Method for lifecycle participation; does nothing but registers the instance.

methods.name: CreateId
methods.description: Creates a system target ID for a given silo address.

methods.name: LogInformationCreatingInMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Logs info about creating an in-memory membership table.

methods.name: LogInformationConnectedToMembershipTableProvider
methods.description: Logs info about successful connection to membership table provider.

methods.name: LogInformationWaitingForMembershipTableProvider
methods.description: Logs info about waiting for the membership table provider to initialize.

methods.name: LogInformationMembershipTableProviderFailedToInitialize
methods.description: Logs info about failure to initialize the membership table provider.

methods.name: LogInformationGrainBasedMembershipTableActivated
methods.description: Logs info when the grain-based membership table is activated.

methods.name: LogInformationInitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Logs info during the initialization of the membership table.

methods.name: LogInformationDeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Logs info on deletion of membership table entries.

methods.name: LogDebugInsertRow
methods.description: Logs debug info when inserting a row.

methods.name: LogInformationInsertRowFailed
methods.description: Logs info when insert row operation fails.

methods.name: LogDebugUpdateRow
methods.description: Logs debug info when updating a row.

methods.name: LogInformationUpdateRowFailed
methods.description: Logs info when update row operation fails.

methods.name: LogDebugUpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Logs debug info when updating liveness of a membership entry.
